# k8s-netinspect

> A minimal Kubernetes network inspection tool for diagnosing CNI and pod connectivity. Detects Calico, Flannel, Weave, Cilium with RBAC validation and colored terminal output.

k8s-netinspect is maintained by marcuspat (Agentic Engineer — Platform Engineering × AI-assisted development).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://marcuspat.github.io/k8s-netinspect/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/marcuspat/k8s-netinspect): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
cargo install k8s-netinspect
```
